name: 80018 · Aurora, CO
findings: ZIP 80018 (Aurora) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80018 (Aurora) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80018 (Aurora) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
